title: Split the hours evenly
prompt: hours is a supplied whole number of hours. people is a supplied whole number of people, at least 1. Declare a double named share that holds the hours split evenly between the people, keeping any fraction. With 7 hours and 2 people, share is 3.5.
hints: What does / give when both sides are int?
One side of the division must be a double before the division happens.
Store hours in a double variable first, or write (double)hours, then divide by people.
checkLabels: share must be hours divided by people, with the fraction kept.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Expects a double variable to make the division fractional.
Converts to double after the whole-number division has already dropped the fraction.

feedback: Work the case with 7 hours and 2 people by hand. If your answer gives 3, the division happened between two ints.
